decisions.reason: Since the pandemic, platforms like Teams and Zoom have commoditised conferencing, and the website showed no signs of traction in 2020–2021, so the option looks unlikely to pay off and its resources are better used in core infrastructure.

Early adoption by data centres and financial hubs, plus a close fit with the firm's owned-fibre, carrier-neutral data centre strategy, justifies keeping and expanding this infrastructure option despite no recent website mentions.
A self-service number ordering portal costs little to maintain, supports the established voice business and fits the real-time provisioning direction, so keeping the option open is still worthwhile.
Direct voice connection services are central to enterprise voice and the move to cloud voice, and cheap to run on the owned network, so there is no strong reason to abandon them.
